Hello! Nice to meet you! Your anthro art is soooooo lovely, and I really love how you incorporate backgrounds. 

I would like to request my angel fox character Lucky. She has a blue rose motif. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HUW35G0XJcLdozEbzrAZCZJrV9daUWuF

If you would prefer to have specific ideas, maybe something similar to the atmosphere of this https://pin.it/6TFbh6u or this https://pin.it/3BYYmvA

I am also very open to artistic freedom! The drive has her reference for her angel outfit, but you are welcome to modify it or draw something else of your choice as long as it suits her elegant (or admittedly sexy lol) tastes! I am also happy to leave the environment to you as well if you have an idea you would rather draw ❤️

If this request is too much, or if you do not wish to draw it, please feel free to decline. Thank you for your consideration! ✨💗

Hello NOIKROS! Your art is amazing and I love the backgrounds you do. Today, I have to scenarios and I wish you can pick which one to draw! ( ˃▽˂)

Scenario 1: The character is at a Japanese summer festival, in a yukata. Paper lanterns surround her. She is not looking towards the camera, and it is more like a candid picture. She is enjoying the liveliness of the festival! Maybe she can be holding a snack or a parasol. Please be as creative as you wish!

Scenario 2: The character is taking a walk while it is raining. The character is turned away from the viewer, but she is holding a clear umbrella and is looking back, towards the viewer. She is very happy, because she loves rain! The background can either be in a city or in a nature scene. That is up to you! In terms of clothing, I will also leave that to you.💚

If neither scenario is good, feel free to do what you like! They are only suggestions and if you desire something else, please go for it. Thank you for your consideration!

https://i.imgur.com/OeTZOuz.png
